research_watchouts: Surface uncertain: 2027 is labelled ROAD MARATHON on 5BIB, but the 2026 edition page was labelled TRAIL RACE with the same venue text.
The 5BIB visible date range reads 20/02-21/03/2027 (apparent typo); race day 21/02 comes from its structured data and Vietnam's Best Marathons. Organiser not named on the pages read.
name: Bac Son Marathon – Na Nhem Festival 2027
short_description: Bac Son Marathon – Na Nhem Festival is on Sunday 21 February 2027 at Quynh Son community tourism village in Bac Son, Lang Son, over 7 km, 15 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: Bac Son Marathon – Na Nhem Festival 2027 is held during the Na Nhem spring festival in Bac Son, Lang Son province. The 5BIB event page lists the start at the commune administrative centre grounds and Quynh Son community tourism village, with routes past revolutionary historic sites. Distances are 7 km, 15 km, 21 km and 42 km, and 5BIB labels the 2027 edition a road marathon. Race day is Sunday 21 February 2027, with a 04:00 start listed on 5BIB.

core_facts.venue: Commune administrative centre grounds and Quynh Son community tourism village

faqs.question: How much does Bac Son Marathon – Na Nhem Festival 2027 cost?
faqs.answer: The 5BIB page lists ordinary prices of VND 222,000 for 7 km, VND 333,000 for 15 km, VND 666,000 for 21 km and VND 888,000 for 42 km. The organiser says prices were kept low on purpose. Registration is through 5BIB.

faqs.question: Is Bac Son Marathon – Na Nhem Festival 2027 a road race?
faqs.answer: 5BIB labels the 2027 edition a road marathon. The 2026 edition's 5BIB page was labelled a trail race over the same village and historic-site routes, so the surface may be mixed. The course runs through a rural valley.
